name: BurnerMan's 0x38's spawn's r4, each game's leftover
why: As BurnerMan's 0x37's (above): his spawner of his third kind 0x38 (0x080D4132: push {r0,r1,r2,r5}; movs r0,#0x38; the spawn) sets r0 alone, and its callers, his own states (their bls at 0x080BE000 and 0x080BE0C4), leave r4 as each game's state runner gave it: BN4's 0x13, BN6's his AI data's address. No code of the 0x38 object reads its +4 to +7 (its block 0x080D4050-0x080D4158 searched)
